statement: For every torsion-free discrete Fuchsian action on the closed disk, of either kind and without finite-generation assumptions, every based loop in its boundary-fixed centralizer has a based filling in that centralizer. The same holds under a specified closed-disk conjugacy. Restriction to the actual partial compactification D union the ordinary boundary set is an isomorphism of topological centralizer groups, proved by exact crosscut barriers and Polish openness. Independently, for every second-countable surface with boundary, the inclusion of the boundary-fixed homeomorphism group induces an injection on the fundamental group, with an explicit parameter-disk collar correction valid for infinitely many boundary components. The spherical quotient and original-operator transport of C68 retain slit or slender locally connected frontiers and the specified plane infinity.
depends_on: Explicit disk Möbius convergence calculation and actual invariant-axis accesses; Jordan crosscut separation with an exact cap-side test; C26/C30 Polish open orbit-map theorem; proper collar construction and normalized circle-family lifts; Yagasaki Theorem 1.1 and Lemma 2.1, with all pointed exceptions checked; actual universal-cover lifting as in C32; C68 spherical quotient/operator comparison; C66 one-end topology comparison
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), infinite-operator zero-level comparison and exact relative frontier extension
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual partial compactification, covering, deck labels, fixed ordinary-boundary points, and specified closed-disk conjugacy are retained. The original Yagasaki primary source was reopened and its complete pointed exception lists checked. No unproved boundary-restriction fibration is used. No arbitrary interior uniformization is assumed to extend to the original prime-end circle.
notes: The Möbius formula proves uniform convergence away from one repelling limit point and hence the actual free proper action on D union its ordinary boundary set. Hyperbolic fixed endpoints together with the ordinary boundary set are dense; commutation controls actual axis tails. Crosscuts with those endpoints have inverse images with the same endpoints, and a third controlled access identifies the cap side, proving identity extension across every limit point. The restriction bijection is between closed Polish groups, so its inverse continuously extends all compact parameter and inverse families. A quotient filling is corrected on a proper collar by convex interpolation of each line boundary map and of each normalized real lift of a circle boundary map. Connectedness makes the lifts identity on the entire parameter boundary. Properness of the collar provides continuity for infinitely many components. The corrected quotient filling lifts through the actual universal cover, fixes every original boundary lift and commutes with every labelled deck map. Trivial, parabolic cyclic and hyperbolic cyclic cases are included explicitly. The remaining arbitrary-action and infinite-domain-pasting steps in C12 remain open.
